_comment: FIXTURE — curated component registry for Leafcutter Atlas mock mode (UXP-551).

build_pipeline.name: Build Pipeline
build_pipeline.description: Phase-agent orchestration: ticket-supervisor drives a single ticket through test-writer, python-coder, pr-reviewer, commit, and pull-request phases.

ac_store.name: AC Store
ac_store.description: Acceptance criteria traceability store persisting ACs as YAML files with bidirectional links to tests and implementations.

agent_registry.name: Agent Registry
agent_registry.description: Central registry of all phase agents with is_ticket_phase flags and produces traits.

ux_prototyping.name: UX Prototyping
ux_prototyping.description: Product-truth authoring pipeline: mock data, mockups, and flows that let a reviewer see the real Atlas running against curated fixtures.

knowledge_system.name: Knowledge System
knowledge_system.description: Cross-surface knowledge graph: surface ingestion from paths.json, node/edge derivation, AC-to-code traceability, and query layer.
